cases.actual_action: Real own unapproved UID1000 endpoint supplies a valid-looking self key/descriptor and sealed proof; no installed root-enrolled witness authority.
cases.required_originals: No role/ROS admission; capture actual peer label, PID/birth and consumer refusal.

cases.actual_action: Use a real distinct own managed PID or stale own retired PID birth against current enrolled role.
cases.required_originals: Capture real /proc birth before/after, challenge and refusal; do not claim edited offline receipt alone.

cases.actual_action: In a dedicated own negative subject actually omit, substitute or unseal one retained source FD.
cases.required_originals: Actual descriptor flags/seals/full bytes and trusted witness/SDK rejection before business dispatch.

cases.actual_action: Launch an own bounded role with an actual different interpreter/runtime map or closed argv.
cases.required_originals: Capture real exe/maps/argv, exact expected pins and refusal.

cases.actual_action: Present an already authorized own root-bootstrap actor's real nonconforming status as a forbidden role; never grant a new capability to an application or host role.
cases.required_originals: Preserve actual kernel capability status and precise rejecting stage. A broader UID/source refusal alone does not prove the specific capability predicate; report coverage honestly.

cases.actual_action: Present an actual own actor already carrying a different fixed profile, or a pre-key witness whose lock/probe is incomplete.
cases.required_originals: No new privilege/LSM exception; capture actual status, seccomp installation and failed reset/exec/fork probes before any private key.

cases.actual_action: A real own docker-default application tries to register as host control/witness or requests metadata for a foreign actual actor.
cases.required_originals: Kernel SO_PEERCRED/caller image/cgroup/LSM capture and refusal; no host-control privilege transfer.

cases.actual_action: Use a separate own local lock file or a genuinely open nonowner FD, while original canonical lease remains protected.
cases.required_originals: Original kernel fdinfo/locks/VFS and actual consumer refusal. Never send the true canonical owning OFD to the application.

cases.actual_action: Dedicated own negative subject uses one actual PID for both roles or actually closes/omits guardian inherited lease FD.
cases.required_originals: Actual PID/FD evidence; guardian retires descendants before original lease release.

cases.actual_action: Replay an actual previous signed proof/enrollment/batch at a fresh challenge, or split real consecutive sample batches.
cases.required_originals: Actual received raw frames, new nonce/counters/times, signature/hash checks and refusal.

cases.actual_action: Use an own bounded helper with actual wrong ancestor/leaf/namespace identity; never move a foreign actor.
cases.required_originals: Actual VFS/membership/64GiB/swap0/cpuset originals and rejection; do not loosen resource floors.

cases.actual_action: Dedicated own bounded subject exposes an actually writable private context or supplies an unapproved issuer/policy file.
cases.required_originals: Actual mountinfo/stat/os.access and SDK-owned policy bytes prove refusal; no writable host-root/canonical/context alias in positive subject.

rules: Each case needs actual own kernel actors/FD/lifecycle/channel evidence and independently reviewed full originals, not static/offline JSON edits.
Keep exact product consumer source and capture precise rejection stage. A mutation rejected earlier does not prove a later specific predicate.
Never create extra privileges, change AppArmor, stop foreign actors, release a foreign lease or omit physical retirement to manufacture coverage.
Source/witness/issuer/executor/mount changes create a new subject requiring whole transfer, exact verification, own two interruptions and own bounded benign.
Wire/crypto conformance cases below are additional prerequisites, not replacements for the12 real actor refusals.
additional_linux_conformance: RSA3072-PSS OpenSSL independent valid vector and exact salt32 verification; bad signature/message/hash/domain/e/salt/trailer/top-bit/range vectors
Duplicate-key/noncanonical/float JSON, framing lengths, batch reorder/duplicate/extra/truncated SCM_RIGHTS and EOF/timeout; verify all receivedFDs closed on every rejection
Root-owned enrollment creation/seals/O_RDONLY admission, UID1000 forged-root refusal, root issuer closure/key transition and no private key in files/FDs/env/archive
Actual fixed-profile caller exe/ns/cgroup/LSM reads, SO_PEERSEC, cross-PID-namespace SO_PEERCRED, readonly socket bind mount and independently reopened object FD delivery
Actual procfs fdinfo SCM_RIGHTS readonly reader survives app LSM mediation, fstatfs/hostproc dev and exact kernel d_path match, full raw SHA/flags/inode/flock
kcmp(KCMP_FILE) actual valid own-role read check, originalFD lifecycle no replacement, all passedFD objects immutable/source or root-runtime or narrow procfs; canonical OFD never delivered
Actual pre-key irreversible execve/execveat/fork/vfork/clone/clone3 and dumpability-reset denial probes, pinned exact filter bytes/source; no privilege fallback
